observed.caption: A busy urban street intersection with tall office buildings, cars, pedestrians, and a motorcyclist under an overcast sky.
observed.description: A wide paved urban roadway with lane markings and traffic light poles extends through the center and foreground, flanked by sidewalks and mature green trees. On the left side, a large light-gray multi-story office building with a grid of many small windows dominates the foreground, with a taller dark-brown high-rise and a narrow weathered concrete tower rising behind it; a distant white cylindrical building is visible in the center background. Vehicles including a black SUV in the center lane, a silver hatchback and white car near the left curb, a light blue car further down the road, and a bus in the distance occupy the roadway. A motorcycle with a rider in a yellow high-visibility jacket and blue helmet travels toward the camera in the foreground right. Multiple pedestrians in varied clothing are walking across crosswalks and standing along both sidewalks. A red double-sided street clock on a red and white pole stands near the left sidewalk corner, above a blue storefront awning. Traffic signals on metal poles hang over the intersection. The sky is overcast and cloudy with diffuse daylight.
